prog='''from collections import Counter

def find_rects(g):
    rects=[]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]
                r2=r
                while r2+1<H and g[r2+1][c]==col: r2+=1
                c2=c
                while c2+1<W and g[r][c2+1]==col: c2+=1
                if r2-r>=2 and c2-c>=2 and g[r2][c2]==col and all(g[i][j]==col for i in range(r,r2+1) for j in (c,c2)) and all(g[i][j]==col for j in range(c,c2+1) for i in (r,r2)):
                    rects.append((r,c,r2,c2,col))
                    for i in range(r,r2+1):
                        for j in range(c,c2+1): seen.add((i,j))
    return rects

def transform(grid):
    g=grid; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    rects=find_rects(g)
    singles=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
             if g[r][c] and not any(x[0]<=r<=x[2] and x[1]<=c<=x[3] for x in rects)]
    cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in singles)
    colors_sorted=sorted(cnt)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for k,(a,cc,b,dd,col) in enumerate(rects):
        fill=colors_sorted[k] if k<len(colors_sorted) else 0
        for i in range(a,b+1):
            for j in range(cc,dd+1):
                if i in(a,b) or j in(cc,dd): out[i][j]=col
                elif (i+j)%2==0: out[i][j]=fill
    return out
'''
